# MetWipe

> MetWipe by Ecrin Labs is a privacy-first browser tool for inspecting and removing supported metadata from files. Supported cleaning happens locally in the user's browser; files are not uploaded to a MetWipe application server for processing.

## Main tool
- https://metwipe.com/ — Inspect, clean, and verify supported metadata in the browser.
- https://metwipe.com/tools.html — Browse all current metadata tools.
- https://metwipe.com/supported-formats.html — Exact supported formats and verification limits.

## Photo metadata
- https://metwipe.com/photo-metadata-tools.html — Photo metadata topic center for EXIF, GPS, device information and safer-sharing workflows.
- https://metwipe.com/exif-viewer.html — Inspect supported EXIF metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/check-exif-metadata.html — Check supported EXIF fields before sharing.
- https://metwipe.com/check-photo-location.html — Check a supported photo for GPS/location metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-exif.html — Remove supported EXIF metadata from JPEG photos.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-gps-from-jpg.html — Remove supported GPS metadata from JPG photos.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-location-data-from-photo.html — Privacy-focused location-data removal workflow.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-camera-info-from-photo.html — Remove supported camera/device EXIF fields.
- https://metwipe.com/batch-photo-metadata-remover.html — Batch-clean supported JPEG, PNG and WebP metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-png-metadata.html — Remove supported PNG metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/check-png-metadata.html — Check supported PNG metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-webp-metadata.html — Remove supported WebP EXIF/XMP metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/check-webp-metadata.html — Check supported WebP metadata.

## Audio metadata
- https://metwipe.com/mp3-metadata-tools.html — MP3 metadata topic center for checking, cleaning and understanding supported tags.
- https://metwipe.com/check-mp3-metadata.html — Inspect supported MP3 metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-mp3-metadata.html — Remove supported MP3 metadata without re-encoding the audio payload.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-album-art-from-mp3.html — Remove supported embedded MP3 artwork metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-mp3-metadata-mac.html — Mac-focused MP3 metadata workflow.
- https://metwipe.com/check-wav-metadata.html — Inspect supported WAV metadata chunks.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-wav-metadata.html — Remove supported WAV metadata chunks.

## Office document metadata
- https://metwipe.com/word-metadata-tools.html — Word/DOCX metadata topic center for checking and removing supported document properties.
- https://metwipe.com/check-word-document-metadata.html — Inspect supported Word/DOCX metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-docx-metadata.html — Remove supported DOCX metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-author-from-word-document.html — Remove supported Author metadata from DOCX.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-last-modified-by-word.html — Remove supported Last Modified By metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-company-metadata-docx.html — Remove supported Company metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/check-xlsx-metadata.html — Inspect supported XLSX metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-xlsx-metadata.html — Remove supported XLSX metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/check-pptx-metadata.html — Inspect supported PPTX metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-pptx-metadata.html — Remove supported PPTX metadata.

## Important capability notes
- Do not assume MetWipe provides a public server-side API, OAuth/OIDC service, or MCP server unless one is explicitly published in the future.
- Metadata support varies by file format. MetWipe does not claim to remove every proprietary or exotic metadata structure.
- User file selection and local browser processing are central to the privacy model.
